note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 26 November 2026, RealHunt lists 4 homes for sale in Ireland, each one checked by a person.
In Ireland, the median asking price of those 4 homes is €230,000 (€2,255 per m², from the 4 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €170,000 and the most expensive €230,000.
Taxes and fees add about 2.5–3.5% to the price of a home in Ireland (figures as of 2026).
With 4 homes this is a small sample, so the median for Ireland is a rough guide.

buying.costs_breakdown: Stamp duty of 1% of the price up to €1 million (2% from €1 million to €1.5 million and 6% above), solicitor's fees of about 1-1.5% plus 23% VAT, and registration fees of €425 to €800; the seller pays the estate agent, whose fee is usually built into the asking price.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. There are no restrictions on foreigners buying homes in Ireland, and owning a home does not give a right to live there.
buying.annual_property_tax: Local Property Tax (LPT): from 2026 a home valued up to €240,000 pays a basic €95 a year and one valued €240,001 to €315,000 pays €235; each council can raise or lower the basic rate by up to 15%, and most raised it by 15% for 2026.

homes.title: Renovated village house with an A3 energy rating near Killala harbour, Mayo
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo renovada con calificación energética A3 cerca del puerto de Killala, Mayo
homes.summary: A recently renovated two-storey house on Gore Street in the centre of Killala, a short stroll from the harbour on Killala Bay. About 95 m²: entrance hall, a 6.5 m sitting room, kitchen and dining room with a new fitted kitchen and a guest WC downstairs, and one very large double bedroom with a shower room upstairs. The agent says it is finished to a high standard. Rare for an older house, it has a BER of A3, with oil central heating and all mains services. There is a paved courtyard at the back. Ballina is about 13 km away. Only one bedroom.

homes.title: Sea-view two-bed end-of-terrace house above the Atlantic in Kilkieran, Connemara
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de dos dormitorios con vistas al mar en el Atlántico en Kilkieran, Connemara
homes.summary: An end-of-terrace house in a small, tidy development on a raised site above the Atlantic near Kilkieran village in Connemara, with wide sea views. About 102 m²: a living room built around a natural stone fireplace with a stove and a door to the garden, a large kitchen and dining room, two double bedrooms (the main one with a vaulted ceiling, Juliet balcony and en suite) and a family bathroom. The village has a shop, school, church and a bar and restaurant; Clifden is about 44 km and Galway about 70 km. Photos show it furnished, clean and bright. BER C3.

homes.title: Three-bed marina-view apartment with roof terrace and boat berth in Leitrim Village
homes.title_es: Apartamento de tres dormitorios con vistas al puerto, terraza en la azotea y amarre de barco en Leitrim Village
homes.summary: A 121 m² three-bedroom apartment for €230,000, sold fully furnished, with a private marina berth included. It faces south-east with open views over the marina, the Shannon-Erne Waterway and Sheemore Hill, from a large front balcony and a private roof terrace. The building has a lift and private parking, and the village shops, pubs and cafés are a short walk away. Gas central heating and a B energy rating. Photos show a bright living and dining room with big windows, a separate kitchen with island and tidy bathrooms. Service charge for 2026 is €2,022.95.

homes.title: Ground-floor two-bed flat with an en suite, a walk from Tramore beach, Waterford
homes.title_es: Piso de planta baja con dos dormitorios y baño en suite, a pie de playa de Tramore, Waterford
homes.summary: A ground-floor flat in the Pebble Beach development in Tramore, within walking distance of the beach and promenade, set among lawns with views of the bay from the estate. About 76 m²: a very large open-plan living, dining and kitchen room with a fireplace, two double bedrooms (the main one with an en suite shower room) and a second bathroom. Photos show it freshly painted, clean and ready to use, with patio doors onto the green. BER B. Waterford city is reached by regular buses. Management charge for 2026: €1,025 a year.
